context: Required checks are green and a person approved, but the repository's review bot is still reviewing the head: its check is pending with 'Review in progress' and its comment says it is reviewing 4e1a9c2. Review bots are advisory with a bounded wait, and the user's 17:00 cut is the deadline: wait for the bot until it finishes or the cut, merge if it finishes clean, and if the cut arrives first, merge without it and tell the user it was skipped.

checklist.name: Does not merge immediately
checklist.description: actions.md does not run gh pr merge, --admin, or enable auto-merge for #88 right away while the CodeRabbit review is visibly in progress; it waits first. Merging immediately because checks are green and a person approved scores 0

checklist.name: Recognizes the running bot review
checklist.description: Cites the pending 'Review in progress' check or the 'Currently reviewing' comment as a review in progress on head 4e1a9c2, and does not treat the empty reviewRequests as meaning review is done

checklist.name: Wait bounded by the cut
checklist.description: Plans a poll until the bot finishes or about 17:00, whichever comes first. If the bot finishes, re-reads checks, threads, and comments and squash-merges when nothing blocks. If 17:00 arrives first, squash-merges without the bot rather than holding past the user's deadline

checklist.name: Skip reported
checklist.description: Tells the user whether CodeRabbit finished; if the merge went in without it, says so plainly and suggests reading its review when it lands

checklist.name: No noise
checklist.description: Posts no status or ping comments on the PR, does not address the bot, and does not request a duplicate review
